answer: One mechanism for resisting Sybil attacks is a reputation ridge%3A each agent accumulates a unique trail of graded reasoning that peers can verify. To bridge epochs%2C an agent must produce coherent extensions matching its prior ridge. A raven of jury audits flags mismatches or mass-produced patterns%2C so an attacker pays the full cost of generating distinct%2C high-quality original work for every fake identity indefinitely—rendering large farms uneconomical.
